arabic: + أَشْكُرُكَ يَا إِلَهَ يَعْقُوبَ: إِلَهٌ قَادِرٌ مَرْهُوبٌ: كَمَّلَ كُلَّ الْمَكْتُوبِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ تَاجِرُ مَدِينَةِ اَلتَّوْرَاةِ: طَلَبَ كَنْزَ اَلْحَيَاةِ: وَجَدَ عَذْرَاءَ فَتَاةً: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ جَازَ بِنُورِهِ بَهَاهُ: دَاخِلَ حَقْلٍ خَبَّأَهُ: وَمِنْهُ اقْتَنَاهُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ حَمَلُ اَللهِ قَدْ صَارَ: كَاهِنًا خَادِمَ اَلْأَسْرَارِ: لِأَنَّهُ رَئِيسُ أَحْبَارٍ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ خَرْدَلٌ أَيْضًا وَخَمِيرٌ: اَلِاثْنَانِ قَالَ اَلْبَشِيرُ: عَنِ اَلْإِيمَانِ يُشِيرُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ خَمِيرٌ فِي سَمِيذٍ: تَجَسَّدَ اَلِابْنُ اَلْوَحِيدُ: خَمَّرَنَا يَوْمَ اَلتَّعْمِيدِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ دُرٌّ وَجَدَهُ إِنْسَانٌ: مَضَى وَبَاعَ كُلَّ مَا كَانَ: وَاشْتَرَى لُؤْلُؤَ اَلْإِيمَانِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ رَسَمَ اَلْحَمَلُ اَلسَّالِمُ: مِنْ قَبْلِ إِنْشَاءِ اَلْعَالَمِ: لِيُذْبَحَ مِنْ أَجْلِ خَلَاصِ آدَمَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ شَرَكٌ حَبَكَهُ اَلشَّيْطَانُ: لِيَصِيدَ آدَمَ اَلْإِنْسَانَ: صَادَهُ وَحَوَّاءَ اَلِاثْنَيْنِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ سَبَقَ لِصٌّ سَلَّابٌ: وَحْشٌ وَنَبِيٌّ كَذَّابٌ: خَدَعَ أَوْلَادَ اَلْآبِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ سَبَاهُمْ بِالْخَطِيَّةِ: مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ رَدِيَّةٍ: دَاسُوا اَلْوَصِيَّةَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ سَبَقَتِ اَلْعَتِيقَةُ: كُتِبَتْ بِالْحَقِيقَةِ: حُجَّةً وَثِيقَةً: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ شَوْكًا وَحَسَكًا تُنْبِتُ لَكَ: زَلَّةُ آدَمَ هَيَّأَتْ لَكَ: إِكْلِيلَ شَوْكٍ صَنَعَتْ لَكَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ صَدَقَتْ مَوَاعِيدُ اَللهِ: كَمَا قَالَتِ اَلتَّوْرَاةُ: يَأْتِي نَسْلُ اَلْمَرْأَةِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ صَبِيٌّ إِلَهٌ قَدِيرٌ: صَنَعَ كُلَّ اَلتَّدْبِيرِ: وَقَتَلَ اَلتِّنِّينَ اَلْكَبِيرَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ صَدَقَتْ جَمِيعُ أَقْوَالِكَ: تَتَقَدَّسُ فِي أَفْعَالِكَ: لِتُخْبِرَ بِأَعْمَالِكَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ ضَلَّ آدَمُ وَأَيْضًا وَاحْتَارَ: حِينَ أَكَلَ مِنَ اَلثِّمَارِ: وَتَاهَ بَيْنَ اَلْأَشْجَارِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ طَلَبَهُ رَبُّهُ بِرِضَاهُ: وَحَلَفَ بِيَمِينٍ وَأَتَاهُ: وَبِدَمِهِ قَدْ فَدَاهُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ طَاهِرٌ وَأَمِينٌ وَصَادِقٌ: كَمَّلَ يَمِينَهُ اَلسَّابِقَ: عَلَى طَقْسِ مَلْكِيصَادِقَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ ظَهَرَ اَلطِّيبُ وَفَاحَ: غَرَسْتُ أَنَا وَأَبِي اَلْفَلَّاحُ: بُسْتَانٌ يُثْمِرُ اَلصَّلَاحَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ عَرُوسٌ بِكْرٌ وَبَتُولٌ: خَطَبَهَا بُولُسُ اَلرَّسُولُ: عَنِ اَلْبِيعَةِ يَقُولُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ غَنَمٌ دَاخِلَ اَلضَّيْعَةِ: تَرْتَعُ وَسَطَ اَلْبِيعَةِ: اَلْأُمُّ اَلْوَدِيعَةُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ فَرَّقَ وَأَعْطَى اَلْمَسَاكِينَ: بِرُّهُ دَائِمٌ كُلَّ حِينٍ: لِشَعْبِهِ اَلْمُجْتَمِعِينَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ فِي سِرِّ اَلْقُرْبَانِ: ثَلَاثَةٌ لَازِمَةٌ لِلْبُنْيَانِ: اَلْحُبُّ وَالرَّجَاءُ وَالْإِيمَانُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ هَيْكَلُ سُلَيْمَانَ: عَمُودَانِ رَفِيعَا اَلْبُنْيَانِ: اَلتَّوْبَةُ وَالْغُفْرَانُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ قَالَ يُوحَنَّا اَلْبَشِيرُ إِنَّ اَلْآبَ اَلْقَدِيرَ: أَرْسَلَ ابْنَهُ اَلْخَبِيرَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ كَمَّلَ كَلَامَ اَلْمَزْمُورِ: رَبُّنَا اشْتَمَلَ بِالنُّورِ: يَمْلِكُ بِالسُّرُورِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ لُوقَا قَالَ بِتَأْوِيلٍ: مَكْتُوبٌ فِي اَلْإِنْجِيلِ: إِنْسَانٌ كَانَ لَهُ وَكِيلٌ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ لَمَّا سَمِعَ بِأَعْمَالِهِ: طَلَبَهُ أَيْضًا وَسَأَلَهُ: يُعْطَى حِسَابَ تَوْكِيلِهِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ لَوْلَا نَامُوسُ إِسْرَائِيلَ: مَا كَانَ رُفِعَ اَلْإِنْجِيلُ: حِكْمَةَ هَذَا اَلْجِيلِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ مَضَى اَلنَّامُوسُ اَلْمَطْلُوبُ: وَثَبَتَ مِيرَاثُ يَعْقُوبَ: وَلَمْ يَتَغَيَّرِ اَلْمَكْتُوبُ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ نَصَبَ حَيَّةَ اَلنُّحَاسِ: فِي بَرِّيَّةِ اَلْقِصَاصِ: وَهِيَ رَمْزُ صَلِيبِ مَاسِيَاسَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ نَطَقَ يَسُوعُ فَوْقَ اَلصَّلِيبِ: وَدَعَا أُمَّهُ وَالْحَبِيبَ: يُوحَنَّا عَالِي اَلنَّصِيبِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ شَرَّفَهُ بِالْعَطِيَّةِ: وَنَزَعَ عَنْهُ اَلْخَطِيَّةَ: فَخْرَ اَلرَّسُولِيَّةِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ هُوَذَا امْرَأَةٌ فِي اَلْجَلَيَانِ: حُبْلَى بِاسْتِعْلَانٍ: وَالِابْنُ اَلْوَحِيدُ مِنْهَا كَانَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ هَرَبَتْ هَذِهِ اَلْمَرْأَةُ بِجَنَاحَيْ أَقْوَالِ اَللهِ: اَلْحَدِيثَةِ وَالتَّوْرَاةِ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ هَرَبَتْ إِلَى اَلْبَرِّيَّةِ: صِهْيَوْنَ اَلنَّقِيَّةِ: لِتَعُولَ اَلذُّرِّيَّةَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ وَاضِعُ هَذَا اَلْمَدِيحِ: اَلْقُمُّصُ عَبْدُ اَلْمَسِيحِ: يُقَدِّمُ اَلتَّسْبِيحَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ لِأَنِّي لَسْتُ مَعْدُودٌ: وَغَرِيبٌ مِنَ اَلشَّيْخِ مَسْعُودٌ: أُقَدِّمُ اَلسُّجُودَ: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ يَا رَبُّ احْفَظْ بَطْرَكَنَا: وَشُرَكَاءَهُ أَسَاقِفَتَنَا: وَبِصَلَوَاتِهِمْ ثَبِّتْنَا: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
+ يَا رَبُّ احْفَظْ كَهَنَتَنَا: وَأَيْضًا شَمَامِسَتَنَا: مَعَ كَافَّةِ أُمَّتِنَا: فِي أَبْوَابِ ابْنَةِ صِهْيَوْنَ.
english: + I thank You O God of Jacob: God powerful and awesome: You fulfilled all that was written: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ A merchant of the city of the Torah: sought the treasure of life: he found a virgin maiden: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ He passed with His light and His splendor: inside a field He hid it: and from it He acquired it: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The Lamb of God has become: a Priest serving the mysteries: for He is the Chief of priests: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Mustard also and leaven: the two the Evangelist said: point to the faith: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Leaven in fine flour: the Only-Begotten Son became incarnate: He leavened us on the day of Baptism: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ A pearl a man found: he went and sold all that he had: and bought the pearl of faith: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The perfect Lamb ordained: before the foundation of the world: to be sacrificed for the salvation of Adam: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ A snare the devil wove: to hunt Adam the man: he hunted him and Eve the two: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ A thief and a robber preceded: a beast and a false prophet: they deceived the children of the Father: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ He took them captive by sin: from a corrupt fruit: they trampled the commandment: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The Old preceded: written in truth: a document and a covenant: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you: Adam's fall prepared for you: a crown of thorns I made for you: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The promises of God were true: as the Torah said: the seed of the woman shall come: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ A Child God Almighty: accomplished all the plan: and killed the great dragon: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ All Your words are true: You are sanctified in Your deeds: to tell of Your works: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Adam strayed and also was confused: when he ate of the fruits: and wandered among the trees: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ His Lord sought him in His pleasure: and swore with an oath and came to him: and by His blood He redeemed him: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Pure and faithful and righteous: He fulfilled His previous oath: after the order of Melchizedek: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The spice appeared and spread its fragrance: I planted and My Father the Husbandman: a garden that bears the fruit of righteousness: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ A bride virgin and chaste: Paul the Apostle betrothed her: of the Church he speaks: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Sheep inside the fold: grazing in the midst of the Church: the gentle Mother: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ He distributed and gave to the poor: His righteousness is everlasting at all times: to His people who are gathered: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ In the mystery of the Eucharist: three are necessary for the building: love and hope and faith: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The temple of Solomon: two pillars of high structure: repentance and forgiveness: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ John the Evangelist said that the Almighty Father: sent His expert Son: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The words of the Psalm were fulfilled: our Lord was clothed with light: He reigns with joy: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Luke said by interpretation: written in the Gospel: a man had a steward: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ When he heard of his deeds: he sought him also and asked him: to give an account of his stewardship: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Were it not for the law of Israel: the Gospel would not have been raised: the wisdom of this generation: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The required law passed away: and the inheritance of Jacob was established: and the written word did not change: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ He set up the bronze serpent: in the wilderness of retribution: and it is a symbol of the cross of Messiah: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Jesus spoke upon the cross: and called His Mother and the beloved: John of high portion: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ He honored him with the gift: and removed from him the sin: the pride of the apostleship: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ Behold a woman in the Revelation: pregnant with manifestation: and the Only-Begotten Son was from her: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ This woman fled with the two wings of the words of God: the New and the Torah: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ She fled to the wilderness: the pure Zion: to nourish the offspring: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ The author of this praise: Hegumen Abdel-Messih: offers the praise: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ For I am not counted: and a stranger from Sheikh Masoud: I offer the prostration: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ O Lord preserve our Patriarch: and his partners our bishops: and by their prayers establish us: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
+ O Lord preserve our priests: and also our deacons: with all our nation: in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
